items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: there was Henry “Red” Allen, J.C. Higginbotham, with an excellent alto man called Don Stovall

ctx.x: Next to the Oriental Theater. Joe Sherman’s Downbeat Room, and there was Henry “Red” Allen, J.C. Higginbotham, with an excellent alto man called Don Stovall, and a drummer Alvin Burrows, and a pianist named General Morgan, whose daughter, Gloria Morgan, became a singer at one of our sessions, and she was excellent too.
Were these pretty much territory musicians?
